Task: Managed Object Storage

Write Python code that reads object metadata or head information from managed object storage using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient

# Replace with your Azure Blob Storage connection string
connection_string = "your_connection_string_here"

# Create a BlobServiceClient
blob_service_client = BlobServiceClient.from_connection_string(connection_string)

# Specify the container name and blob name
container_name = "your_container_name"
blob_name = "your_blob_name"

# Get the blob client
blob_client = blob_service_client.get_blob_client(container=container_name, blob=blob_name)

# Get the blob metadata
metadata = blob_client.get_blob_metadata()

# Print the metadata
print(metadata)
```
